correctness.rationale: Expanded all four original ODEs into total/difference coordinates and established exact entropy identity Vdot=-cA²-(pγ/ρ)B² by symbolic computation. Compact positive entropy levels and LaSalle give global convergence; the 2D strong-stable plane is exactly the symmetric subspace. A center-manifold invariance equation gives W=(2iωI-J)^(-1)F. Averaging squared second-harmonic forcing in the entropy identity proves \(tR^2\)->1/(2uD), with D>0. Exact SymPy verifies W and \(D=9/520\) at unit parameters; three long finite integrations support but do not prove the asymptotic. The analytic proof and checker are included.

value.rationale: The source explicitly flags a symmetry-induced dissipation degeneracy blocking strong uniform stochastic timing arguments. The new deterministic theorem identifies the actual slow relaxation mechanism and gives an exact universal \(t^{-1/2}\) coefficient for all positive asymmetric histories, contrasted with exponential relaxation in a natural invariant subspace. It quantifies a meaningful ecological transient, not a numerical tweak or a restatement of convergence; it explicitly does not claim the unresolved stochastic estimate.
